name: NinjaTek NinjaFlex 85A (Midnight Black)
source: PrusaResearch 2.5.12: NinjaTek NinjaFlex TPU, classic MK3 / 0.4 mm; NinjaTek printing guidelines and technical data

retraction.note: Prusa NinjaTek NinjaFlex TPU filament overrides for a classic direct-drive MK3-family setup.

notes: Non-foaming 85A TPU. Matches the linked 1.75 mm, 1 kg Midnight Black spool, SKU 3DNF0117510. Temperatures, density, flow cap, multiplier and retraction come from Prusa's NinjaFlex preset. Cooling is adapted to this engine's path roles: bed/base paths off, supported and raised paths 60%; Prusa's gradual layer fan ramp is not reproduced. This is a reference preset, not a physically qualified textile print. Direct-drive reference; other extruders may need tuning.

provenance.reference_printer: Original Prusa i3 MK3S & MK3S+ (0.4 mm)
